user.title: Bambu Print Costs
user.description: Pick the printer sensors this integration should read. Only the first two are required.

data_description.print_weight: The sensor whose attributes hold the per-slot filament weight for the current job.
data_description.cover_image: Optional. Captured and stored with each logged job.

costs.title: Filament slots and rates
costs.description: Add one slot per filament source, using the exact attribute name from the print weight sensor — for example 'AMS 1 Tray 1'. Optionally add a label and a tray sensor after pipes: 'AMS 1 Tray 1|A1|sensor.printer_ams_tray_1'. The tray sensor supplies the colour and material for the job log, and its tag_uid prices the slot from the tag library. Leave empty if you do not use an AMS.

data_description.energy_sensors: Summed to work out the energy a print used. Usually the printer and AMS socket meters.
data_description.default_filament_price: Used for a slot with no price set, and for filament from an unconfigured source.
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Optional. Follows a variable tariff — point it at a sensor reporting the price per kWh (e.g. EUR/kWh). When set it overrides the fixed price below, which stays as the fallback for when the sensor is unavailable.

init.title: Printer sensors
init.description: Change which sensors this integration reads.

costs.title: Filament slots and rates
costs.description: Adding or removing a slot creates or removes its price entity.

data_description.electricity_price_entity: Optional. Follows a variable tariff — point it at a sensor reporting the price per kWh (e.g. EUR/kWh). When set it overrides the fixed price below, which stays as the fallback for when the sensor is unavailable.

write_tags.name: Write tag library
write_tags.description: Replace the whole filament tag library. The previous file is kept as tags.csv.bak.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Bambu Print Costs entry is set up.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: List of tag objects: filament, color_code, color_name, serial, cost_per_kg, disabled.

set_tag_price.name: Set tag price
set_tag_price.description: Update the price of every tag carrying a serial number.

log_job.name: Log job
log_job.description: Append the finished job to the log. Anything not supplied is read from the configured sensors.

job.name: Job name
job.description: Defaults to the job name sensor.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-read the CSV files from disk.

import_legacy.name: Import legacy CSV
import_legacy.description: Bring tags and job history in from the pre-integration CSV files. Paths must be inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.

tags_path.name: Tags CSV
tags_path.description: Path to the old filament tag CSV, e.g. /config/www/bambu_tags.csv.

jobs_path.name: Jobs CSV
jobs_path.description: Path to the old job log CSV, e.g. /config/www/bambu_jobs_log.csv.

covers_path.name: Covers folder
covers_path.description: Folder holding the job cover images referenced by the job log.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Wipe existing data first. Off by default, which merges and skips duplicates.

sync_slot_prices.name: Sync slot prices
sync_slot_prices.description: Copy the loaded spool's tag price into each slot's price number. Runs automatically when a print starts.
